findings.message: request parameter limit (query) is now required
findings.explanation: Server profile: existing callers that omit the parameter will be rejected. Client profile: the new client always sends it.
Existing clients calling this endpoint will get 404 / not-found errors. Removing an operation is the most direct breaking change.

findings.message: request field `email` changed from string to integer
findings.explanation: Consumers parse this value as the old type; a different type breaks deserialization, validation, and downstream logic.
Server profile: existing callers do not send this field and will be rejected. Client profile: older servers may reject an unknown required field under strict validation.
Values that existing clients or servers rely on are no longer valid.
